nonBlockingObservations.title: Make post-run gate identity verification independent of the run preflight
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The post-run checker verifies detached HEAD at clean main, one commit after BASE, and exactly the four run output paths. It does not independently compare that intervening commit’s changed paths and candidate bytes with product-map.json or compare HEAD with the productBase recorded by the run. The blind run’s preflight does perform the stronger gate-map verification before access. Thus the planned sequential run under the explicit freeze is covered, but the post-checker’s own claim that it recognizes the gate commit relies on that earlier check and the freeze remaining in force.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: For independent reuse, have the checker compare its HEAD with the completed run record’s productBase and/or repeat the reviewed gate-map path/byte checks. Until then, retain the exact run plan’s freeze through the checks and post-run review; do not treat this checker as proof for an arbitrary one-commit descendant of BASE.
